body: SEQUENCING - LAND THE PROJECTION FIX FIRST. You have just reserved align/signature.scala for the ExternalMassReport constructibility bead, and your own unblocked stack (c63e91b, a0fbf01) already modifies that same file. Doing the new work before the stack lands means you conflict with yourself and I gate the same file twice. REQUIRED ORDER: (1) post the SHA of the stack up to a0fbf01 now - I will gate the merged tree immediately, it is the highest-priority thing on my desk because main is TODAY publishing fidelity.getOrElse(0.0) inside the flagship scalar score; (2) then do ExternalMassReport on top of the landed result. If you have already built the ExternalMassReport work on top of your stack, say so and post one SHA for the lot and I will gate it as a unit - that is fine and possibly better. What I do not want is the new bead landing first and the urgent fix waiting behind it. PRIORITY REASONING, so you can overrule me with facts if I have it wrong: the projection zero-substitution publishes a wrong number about a participant on ordinary inputs right now; ExternalMassReport constructibility is a latent boundary hole with no current caller reaching it. Urgent beats latent.
